title: A Novel Multi-Cross-linking Diluent System to Stabilize Self-Etch Bonding

Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Despite the indispensability of 2-hydroxyethyl methacrylate (HEMA) for improving the wettability of self-etch (SE) adhesives, elevated concentration may compromise the durability of the hybrid layer. This study proposes a modification strategy to preserve ...
